_comment: Gleo Interface App Schema (draft). Register on Pleos Playground > Workspace > App Integration. Field names follow the App Schema Writing Guide; verify against the current guide before submission.

description.ko: 목적지 가이드를 들려주는 차량용 오디오 가이드
description.en: In-car audio guide for your destination

functions.name: SKIP_EPISODE
functions.description: Skip the current story and play the next one. Utterances: 넘겨, 다음 이야기, skip, next story

functions.name: TELL_MORE
functions.description: Replay the current story in more depth with its source. Utterances: 더 자세히, 더 알려줘, tell me more

functions.name: SAVE_PLACE
functions.description: Save the place or phrase just mentioned to the travel log. Utterances: 저장해, 기억해 줘, save this

functions.name: QUIET
functions.description: Pause the guide until the next waypoint. Utterances: 조용히, 그만, quiet, pause

functions.name: WHERE_NEXT
functions.description: Suggest nearby places to go next based on time of day and stay data. Utterances: 다른 데 없어?, 다음은 어디?, where next, anywhere else

functions.name: GO_THERE
functions.description: Route the navigation to a suggested place. Utterances: 거기로 가자, 두 번째로 가자, let's go there, take me to the second one

index.description: 1-based index of the suggestion, if the driver named one

place.description: place name, if the driver said it

functions.name: RESERVE
functions.description: Call the recommended restaurant or cafe to reserve. Utterances: 예약해 줘, 전화 걸어, reserve a table

functions.name: SHOW_TRAVEL_LOG
functions.description: Show today's travel log on screen and read the summary. Utterances: 오늘 일지 보여 줘, show the travel log

functions.name: PREVIOUS_EPISODE
functions.description: Go back to the previous story. Utterances: 이전 이야기, 아까 거, 뒤로, previous, go back

functions.name: REPLAY_EPISODE
functions.description: Hear the current story again from the start. Utterances: 다시 들려줘, 한 번 더, replay, again

functions.name: ANSWER_QUIZ
functions.description: Answer the open kids quiz by number or by naming the option. Utterances: 2번, 이순신 장군, number two

answer.description: Spoken answer: option number or option text
